_about: Curated CORDIS DET queries for Erasmus+ call subjects, keyed by the subject the tagger looks up (Call.topic_title where present, else the call title / Call.name). Subjects auto-extracted verbatim from the grouped work-programme JSON, queries hand/AI-authored in the contenttype=project phrase-quoted style of cluster_1.json/cluster_3.json. CORDIS indexes EU RESEARCH projects (FP1-Horizon Europe); for non-research calls these find thematically related research, so a call's tags are the research fields of related funded projects, NOT its official scope. Re-run POST /cordis/tag-calls {"source":"erasmus"} to apply. NOTE: the three ERASMUS-EDU-2026-PI-ALL-INNO-* calls (Blueprint / Education-Enterprises / STEM) all carry the same Call.topic_title 'Partnerships for Innovation - Alliances for Innovation', so the tagger groups them as ONE subject and only the merged key of that exact name is reachable; the three longer '- Blueprint / - Alliances ... / - ... in STEM education' keys below are kept for intent/provenance but never match a subject as loaded.
